resources.string: This older draft is retained. Continue it explicitly before changing or saving its fields.
Discard these saved fields from this device? No event is changed, and no calendar or event is selected automatically.
Permanently stop the exact original request before discarding this draft. This cannot undo an event that was already saved. If dispatch or a local commit is recorded, the draft is retained.

Discard the old draft only after its original request is safely retired. A new draft needs a fresh explicit Save. Copied creation fields require choosing a calendar again; edits can continue only in the original calendar namespace.
Retirement could not be confirmed. The original draft is retained. Check its status before trying again.
The original request may have been dispatched. It cannot be discarded or replaced safely yet. Review its outcome.
A local commit is recorded. Retirement cannot undo that save or authorize another creation. Review the original outcome.
The journal does not match this exact original request. The draft is retained for review.
This older request cannot be safely retired here. The original draft is retained.
The original calendar identity is unavailable. No replacement calendar is selected automatically.
The operation finished on this device. Draft cleanup remains separate from retirement.
